title: Side setback, walls up to 3.5 m high (R30-R60)
text: C3.4.1 Buildings are set back from lot boundaries in accordance with Table 3.4a. Refer Figure 3.4a, b, c. Table 3.4a Lot boundary setbacks, side setback: Wall height up to 3.5m 1m.

verified.note: C3.4.1(ii) stops at R25, so R30-R60 has no pedestrian access way reduction. Table 4A (p7) agrees (1m).

notes: from: ch3 C3.4.1#side-to-3.5m-r30-r40 and C3.4.1#side-to-3.5m-r50, merged into one R30-R60 record (same Table 3.4a value 1 m, no pedestrian access way reduction above R25; Chapter 4 Part 1 has no R80+ or R100-SL codes). Rounding gap between wall-height bands unresolved. Applies only where the building has walls up to 3.5 m high (condition on building.has_walls_to_3_5m); the band does not depend on the building's maximum wall height.
